nodes.description: Owner address state variable; set in constructor and used for privileged access checks (delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress) and for the whitelist short-circuit in ensure().
Public mapping of token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances; decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting how many times each address has sold; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Private whitelist mapping used by ensure() to bypass sale-condition checks for selected addresses.
Minimum sale value threshold configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Maximum sale value threshold configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Per-address sale count limit configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Privileged trade address set by setTradeAddress(); bypasses ensure() checks.
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Constant decimals value (18) used to scale supply and sale limits; exponentiation performed in init().
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) that mutates allowance and balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic before calling ensure().
Internal view whitelist gate; returns true for owner, UNI router, computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise delegates to condition().
Internal view sale-condition evaluator using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve(address,uint) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata.
Owner-only initializer computing _minSale/_maxSale with unchecked exponentiation and multiplication.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter for the privileged tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using keccak256 and the init code hash.
Payable constructor that mints totalSupply to msg.sender and grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance owner, and as transfer spender.
Low-level delegatecall executing arbitrary external code in the context of this contract.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend can overflow, understating the required balance.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath, allowing allowance underflow.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath, allowing balance underflow/overflow.
token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init() performed without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Sender address parameter of transferFrom(), also used as allowance and balance key.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom(), subtracted from allowance and balances.
Address being checked against the ensure() whitelist.
Recipient address checked against the ensure() owner bypass.
Value forwarded from ensure() into condition().
Local variable holding the pairFor-derived pair address compared in ensure().
Address whose _onSaleNum is evaluated in condition().
Value compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
Target address of the owner-only delegatecall.
User-supplied calldata passed to the delegatecall.
Sale count limit assigned to _saleNum in init().
Minimum sale token amount scaled by 10**decimals in init().
Maximum sale token amount scaled by 10**decimals in init().
Array of recipient addresses multiplied by _value to compute total.
Per-recipient amount multiplied by _tos.length in batchSend.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length computed without overflow protection.
Loop counter used when iterating over _tos in batchSend.
New privileged trade address assigned to tradeAddress.
Factory address used as the first argument of the pair address computation.
First token address sorted in pairFor().
Second token address sorted in pairFor().
Local variable holding the computed pair address returned by pairFor().
